replies.author: @Interless368
replies.text: Thank you for sharing your perspective. We understand that Afghanistan has endured decades of war, foreign intervention, and immense human suffering. These are important parts of the country's history that should never be overlooked. Our intention is not to attack Afghanistan or its people, but to explore different realities, challenges, and stories from around the world. We have great respect for the Afghan people, their culture, and their resilience. Our goal is to show the world, not to judge it.
